responsibility: Defines the front end’s target-description data structures and target ABI/query interface. It captures OS, pointer and floating-point sizes, object/library filename conventions, CPU feature selection, C/C++/Objective-C runtime and ABI properties, and provides methods for alignment, varargs type selection, vector support, calling convention decisions, pass-by-reference/return-on-stack rules, predefined target identifiers, and target-info queries used by semantic analysis and backend glue.
